messages:
maya: Noticed weird provisional token inflation in the rollout dashboard during the last canary window. Suspect reconnects + truncated streams.

chen: Do you have a sample session id or minimal log? Could be toolcall retries.

maya: Sample: session 2f8c, client disconnected at chunk boundary (approx token 420), retried, router started a fresh toolcall instead of resume. Billing shows both attempts provisional.

oscar: If the router can't handoff resume token, billing will count both attempts until finalization. We need a way to link attempts.

priya: Two approaches: add attempt_uuid propagated to billing, or infer by matching session+nearby timestamps and overlapping token ranges. First is robust.

kevin: Adding attempt_uuid sounds right but we must avoid changing too many proto surfaces. Maybe add optional headers: X-Attempt-UUID, X-Resume-Offset. Router can set them on handoff.

maya: Also: console currently plots "provisional credits" per attempt and sums them. That yields spikes during noisy clients. We should present both raw and deduped provisional counts.

oscar: For billing side, we can store provisional entries keyed by attempt_uuid and on finalize, compute the union of token ranges to avoid double-billing. If resume_offset provided, just subtract overlap.

priya: Caveat: some legacy clients won't provide resume_offset, so heuristics needed. We can mark those provisional rows as "unlinked" and run a reconciliation job that attempts to merge near-duplicates.

kevin: Telemetry: emit router.attempt_link_miss and billing.provisional_overlap_pct. Add a grafana panel for the canary dashboard.

maya: UX: add a tiny pill near the quota chart "deduped view" with explanation. Default remain raw for transparency but set deduped as the recommended view.

oscar: Security: ensure attempt_uuid is opaque and not customer-identifiable. Use v4 uuid.

priya: Implementation plan: 1) router header PR (optional headers), 2) billing ingestion accepts attempt_uuid + resume_offset and stores provisional with attempt keys, 3) reconciliation job for backfill, 4) console toggle + panel.

kevin: Who takes router header PR? I can pick it up. Maya can prototype console mock. Priya + chen will coordinate billing ingestion changes.

ops-bot: canary start detected: api-canary-2025-06-20 by kevin at 2025-06-20T09:15:00Z

maya: Action items in ticket 7842. Let's keep an eye on billing.provisional_overlap_pct > 8% during the canary. If it spikes, we pause.

chen: One more edge: toolcalls that call external tool providers may have their own retries. We should include upstream_attempt_meta in logs to avoid misattribution.

priya: Good point. We'll include upstream_tool_id in the provisional record. That helps dedupe across downstream retries.

kevin: I'll open the router PR with header names: X-Attempt-UUID, X-Resume-Offset, X-Attempt-TS. Drafting now.

maya: Thanks. Keep the canary running but watch metrics closely. Small UX change first (toggle), then backend dedupe.

oscar: Also propose a small integration test that simulates disconnect/resume and asserts provisional dedupe works.

priya: Will add that to the billing test suite.

maya: Thanks team. Ping in #oncall if we need to pause. :white_check_mark:
